lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa raas na sach hai kiu tinaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khotai vanaj vana(n)jiai man tan khotaa hoi ||
lines.translation: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: phaahee phaathe mirag jiu dookh ghano nit roi ||2||
lines.translation: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote potai naa pavahi tin har gur daras na hoi ||
lines.translation: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote jaat na pat hai khot na seejhas koi ||
lines.translation: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khote khot kamaavanaa aai gaiaa pat khoi ||3||
lines.translation: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man samajhaaeeai gur kai sabad saalaah ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ra(n)g ratiaa bhaar na bharam tinaah ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: har jap laahaa agalaa nirabhau har man maah ||4||23||
lines.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan joban ar phulaRaa naatheeaRe din chaar ||
lines.translation: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paban kere pat jiu dhal dhul ju(n)manahaar ||1||
lines.translation: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g maan lai piaariaa jaa joban nau hulaa ||
lines.translation: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: din thoRaRe thake bhaiaa puraanaa cholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan mere ra(n)gule jaai sute jeeraan ||
lines.translation: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n) bhee va(n)njaa dumanee rovaa jheenee baan ||2||
lines.translation: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kee na sunehee goreee aapan ka(n)nee soi ||
lines.translation: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lagee aavahi saahurai nit na peeeaa hoi ||3||
lines.translation: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sutee peeeai jaan viratee sa(n)n ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: gunaa gavaaee ga(n)thaRee avagan chalee ba(n)n ||4||24||
lines.translation: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar doojaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape raseeaa aap ras aape raavanahaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape hovai cholaRaa aape sej bhataar ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g rataa meraa saahib rav rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape maachhee machhulee aape paanee jaal ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape jaal manakaRaa aape a(n)dar laal ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bahu bidh ra(n)gulaa sakheee meraa laal ||
lines.translation: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nit ravai sohaaganee dekh hamaaraa haal ||3||
lines.translation: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pranavai naanak benatee too saravar too ha(n)s ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: kaul too hai kaveeaa too hai aape vekh vigas ||4||25||
lines.translation: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan dharatee beej karamaa karo salil aapaau saari(n)gapaanee ||
lines.translation: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man kirasaan har ridai ja(n)maai lai iu paavas pad nirabaanee ||1||
lines.translation: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe garabas mooRe maaiaa ||
lines.translation: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pit suto sagal kaalatr maataa tere hohi na a(n)t sakhaaiaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai bikaar dusat kirakhaa kare in taj aatamai hoi dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam hohi jab raakhe kamal bigasai madh aasramaaee ||2||
lines.translation: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bees sapataaharo baasaro sa(n)grahai teen khoRaa nit kaal saarai ||
lines.translation: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: das athaar mai apara(n)paro cheenai kahai naanak iv ek taarai ||3||26||
lines.translation: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||
